notes.title: Important demo update!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]Thanks so much for all the feedback for the demo—it’s been super helpful! Based on your input, I’ve made some exciting updates to shake up the combat and bring a bit more flair and challenge to the game.[/p][p][b]🔥 What’s New:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Ranged Sword Attack:[/b] The sword now gains a ranged attack after collecting a new powerup![/p][/*][*][p][b]Bullet Hell Combat:[/b] Combat has been reworked to feel more like a bullet hell[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Cursor Support:[/b] A cursor has been added to the [b]main menu[/b] and [b]options menu[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Puzzle:[/b] A small gate puzzle has been added to mix things up a bit.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Fire up the demo to check it out, and feel free to offer your thoughts![/b][/p]
